description: Decision Queue/Triage System - production-grade queue management with named queues, source tracking, triage support (decide-by dates, snooze, priority routing), retention policies, and notification tracking.
steps: Create src/nexus/governance/decision_queue.py with the following components:

DecisionQueueItem dataclass: id UUID, queue_id UUID, decision_id UUID, source_kind str (agent/system/workflow), source_id UUID, priority int (1=highest), status str (pending/decided/snoozed/archived), decide_by datetime|None, snoozed_until datetime|None, needs_notification bool default True, notification_delivered bool default False, created_at datetime, updated_at datetime
RetentionPolicy dataclass: auto_archive_after_days int (default 30), auto_delete_after_days int|None (default None)
DecisionQueueManager class: __init__(retention_policy: RetentionPolicy|None = None). Internal state: dict of queue_name -> list[DecisionQueueItem].

Methods on DecisionQueueManager: create_queue(name: str, company_id: UUID) -> UUID, add_item(queue_name: str, decision_id: UUID, source_kind: str, source_id: UUID, priority: int = 5, decide_by: datetime|None = None) -> DecisionQueueItem, get_pending(queue_name: str, limit: int = 50) -> list sorted by priority then created_at, snooze_item(item_id: UUID, until: datetime), decide_item(item_id: UUID, decision: str), mark_notification_delivered(item_id: UUID), apply_retention() -> int (returns count of archived items), get_overdue(queue_name: str|None = None) -> list[DecisionQueueItem] where decide_by < now and status=pending, list_queues() -> list of queue names

Create tests/test_decision_queue.py: Test queue creation, item addition with priorities, get_pending sorting, snooze/decide/archive lifecycle, retention policy application, overdue detection, notification tracking
acceptance_criteria: DecisionQueueManager creates named queues and adds items
get_pending returns items sorted by priority (ascending) then created_at
snooze_item sets snoozed_until and status to 'snoozed'
apply_retention archives items older than auto_archive_after_days
get_overdue returns items past their decide_by date
findings: All 39 new tests pass. Full suite at 1027 tests (up from 988). Module exported from governance __init__.py. Follows same dataclass-based in-memory pattern as approvals.py.
